sentences.zh: 我不认识博。

sentences.en: I know Hunter.
sentences.zh: 我认识亨特。

sentences.en: Yeah, you know Beau.
sentences.zh: 是啊，你认识博。

sentences.en: Hunter got thrown out of the military.
sentences.zh: 亨特被军队开除了。

sentences.en: He was thrown out, dishonorably discharged...
sentences.zh: 他是被开除的，是不光彩退伍……

sentences.en: That's not true.
sentences.zh: 那不是真的。

sentences.en: He wasn't dishonorably discharged...
sentences.zh: 他不是不光彩退伍……

sentences.en: ...for cocaine use...
sentences.zh: ……是因为吸食可卡因……

sentences.en: And his response was really dismissive.
sentences.zh: 而他的回应非常轻蔑。

sentences.en: He said, I don't know Beau.
sentences.zh: 他说，我不认识博。

sentences.en: I know Hunter.
sentences.zh: 我认识亨特。

sentences.en: And then immediately leans back into a really harsh personal attack on Joe Biden's living son.
sentences.zh: 然后立刻又转回对乔·拜登在世儿子的严厉人身攻击。

sentences.en: He made a fortune in Ukraine, in China, in Moscow...
sentences.zh: 他在乌克兰、中国、莫斯科发了财……

sentences.en: That is simply not true.
sentences.zh: 那根本不是事实。

sentences.en: He made a fortune, gentlemen, and he didn't have a job.
sentences.zh: 先生们，他发了财，而且他当时没有工作。

sentences.en: My son, like a lot of people, like a lot of people you know at home, had a drug problem.
sentences.zh: 我的儿子，像许多人一样，像你们在家乡认识的许多人一样，曾有过药物问题。

sentences.en: He's overtaken it.
sentences.zh: 他已经克服了。

sentences.en: He's fixed it.
sentences.zh: 他已经解决了。

sentences.en: He's worked on it.
sentences.zh: 他为此付出了努力。

sentences.en: And I'm proud of him.
sentences.zh: 我为他感到骄傲。

sentences.en: But why was he given tens of millions of dollars?
sentences.zh: 但为什么他能得到数千万美元？

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: But he wasn't given tens of millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 但他并没有得到数千万美元。

sentences.en: He was given tens of millions of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 他得到的是特朗普总统的数千万美元。

sentences.en: It's interesting in this extremely intense moment involving the president's son, not only did Joe Biden not lose his cool,
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，在这个涉及总统儿子的极其紧张的时刻，乔·拜登不仅没有失去冷静，

sentences.en: he seemed to go out of his way not to retaliate in a way that, because if you're a political strategist, might have felt kind of intuitive.
sentences.zh: 他似乎还特意不去进行那种如果你是政治策略家可能会觉得很直觉的报复。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我想那是对的。

sentences.en: And he really actually drew attention to that fact at a couple different points, saying, you know...
sentences.zh: 而且他实际上在几个不同的点上确实引起了人们对这一事实的注意，他说，你知道……

sentences.en: Here's the deal.
sentences.zh: 事实是这样的。

sentences.en: We want to talk about families and ethics.
sentences.zh: 我们想谈谈家庭和道德。

sentences.en: I don't want to do that.
sentences.zh: 我不想那样做。

sentences.en: I mean, his family we could talk about all night.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他的家庭我们可以谈上一整晚。

sentences.en: His family's already...
sentences.zh: 他的家庭已经……

sentences.en: My family lost a fortune by coming down and helping us with governance.
sentences.zh: 我的家人因为下来帮助我们治理国家而损失了一大笔钱。

sentences.en: And that's such a...
sentences.zh: 那真是……

sentences.en: And they're right here, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 他们就在这儿，总统先生。

sentences.en: That's such a great...
sentences.zh: 那真是个……

sentences.en: Every single one of them lost a fortune.
sentences.zh: 他们每个人都损失了一大笔钱。

sentences.en: The honest answer to that question is, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 对那个问题的诚实回答是，我不知道。

sentences.en: I think the theory of the debate and of the campaign on the Biden side of this is that when they're talking about the president and the coronavirus and the economy,
sentences.zh: 我认为拜登阵营在辩论和竞选中的策略是，当他们谈论总统、新冠病毒和经济时，

sentences.en: they are winning.
sentences.zh: 他们是赢家。

sentences.en: And when they are talking about the president's chosen topics, then that gives the president at least some political oxygen that he wouldn't ordinarily have.
sentences.zh: 而当他们谈论总统选择的话题时，那至少会给总统提供一些他通常不会有的政治氧气。

sentences.en: So why would you have a protracted debate about family ethics when you are winning the debate on the main issue of the election?
sentences.zh: 所以，当你已经在选举的主要议题上赢得了辩论，为什么还要进行一场关于家庭道德的长期辩论呢？

sentences.en: So let's talk about the pandemic, because it seems that one of the ways that President Trump would need to change the nature of this campaign,
sentences.zh: 那么我们来谈谈大流行病，因为特朗普总统似乎需要改变这场竞选的性质，

sentences.en: which you said was his goal in this debate, given the polling, is by changing how people think about his handling of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，考虑到民调，这是他在这次辩论中的目标，即改变人们对他处理新冠病毒方式的看法。

sentences.en: So how did that go?
sentences.zh: 那么进展如何？

sentences.en: President Trump did a phenomenal job.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统做得非常出色。

sentences.en: We did.
sentences.zh: 我们做到了。

sentences.en: We got the gowns.
sentences.zh: 我们拿到了防护服。

sentences.en: We got the masks.
sentences.zh: 我们拿到了口罩。

sentences.en: We made the ventilators.
sentences.zh: 我们制造了呼吸机。

sentences.en: You wouldn't have made ventilators.
sentences.zh: 你们本来是造不出呼吸机的。

sentences.en: Well, for the most part, we heard from the president what we have heard before on the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在很大程度上，我们从总统那里听到的还是我们之前在大流行病问题上听到过的内容。

sentences.en: So we built the greatest economy in history.
sentences.zh: 所以我们建立了历史上最伟大的经济。

sentences.en: We closed it down because of the China plague.
sentences.zh: 因为中国瘟疫，我们关闭了它。

sentences.en: When the plague came in, we closed it down, which was very hard.
sentences.zh: 当瘟疫来袭时，我们关闭了它，这非常困难。

sentences.en: But what happened is we closed it down and now we're reopening and we're doing record business.
sentences.zh: 但发生的事情是，我们关闭了它，现在我们正在重新开放，并且业务创下了纪录。

sentences.en: He defended his handling.
sentences.zh: 他为自己的处理方式进行了辩护。

sentences.en: And now we're weeks away from a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 现在距离疫苗还有几周时间。

sentences.en: We're doing therapeutics already.
sentences.zh: 我们已经在进行治疗了。

sentences.en: He dangled the possibility of a fast vaccine.
sentences.zh: 他抛出了快速获得疫苗的可能性。

sentences.en: We know that there are a lot of reasons to believe that that is not an imminent development.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，有很多理由相信那并不是即将发生的发展。

sentences.en: We should be providing all the protective gear possible.
sentences.zh: 我们应该提供所有可能的防护装备。

sentences.en: We should be providing the money the House has passed in order to...
sentences.zh: 我们应该提供众议院通过的资金，以便……

sentences.en: We heard from Joe Biden, I think, a somewhat more restrained critique of the president than we might have expected.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们从乔·拜登那里听到了比我们预期中对总统稍微克制一点的批评。

sentences.en: He talked about the importance of wearing masks.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了戴口罩的重要性。

sentences.en: He talked about the importance of social distancing.
sentences.zh: 他谈到了保持社交距离的重要性。

sentences.en: There wasn't the kind of top-to-bottom denunciation of the president's handling that I think some of us might have expected coming into the debate.
sentences.zh: 并没有出现我认为我们有些人进入辩论前可能预料到的那种对总统处理方式的全面谴责。

sentences.en: You folks at home, how many of you get up this morning and had an empty chair at the kitchen table because someone died of COVID?
sentences.zh: 你们在家里的各位，今天早上有多少人起床时发现餐桌旁空着一把椅子，因为有人死于新冠？

sentences.en: He did use that segment to talk directly to people who had lost family members and loved ones in the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 他确实利用那一段直接与在大流行病中失去家人和亲人的人们进行了对话。

sentences.en: How many of you were in a situation where you lost your mom or dad and you couldn't even speak to them?
sentences.zh: 你们中有多少人处于那种失去了父母却甚至无法与他们说话的情况？

sentences.en: You had a nurse holding a phone up so you could, in fact, say goodbye.
sentences.zh: 你让护士举着电话，这样你才能真正地告别。

sentences.en: You would have lost far more people.
sentences.zh: 你们本来会失去更多的人。

sentences.en: How many people?
sentences.zh: 多少人？

sentences.en: Far more people.
sentences.zh: 更多的人。

sentences.en: You would have been months late.
sentences.zh: 你们本来会晚几个月。

sentences.en: And by the way, his own CDC director says we could lose as many as another 200 times.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，他自己的疾控中心主任说我们可能会再失去多达200倍的人。

sentences.en: But there, too, we saw him really struggle to keep his focus and flow amid the president's interruption.
sentences.zh: 但在那里，我们也看到他在总统的打断下，努力保持自己的焦点和思路。

sentences.en: I don't trust him at all, nor do you.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不信任他，你也不信任。

sentences.en: I know you don't.
sentences.zh: 我知道你不信任。

sentences.en: What we trust is a scientiSt.
sentences.zh: 我们信任的是科学家。

sentences.en: You don't trust Johnson and Johnson, Pfizer.
sentences.zh: 你不信任强生公司、辉瑞公司。

sentences.en: Okay, by the way.
sentences.zh: 好吧，顺便说一下。

sentences.en: Gentlemen, let me move on to questions about the future because you both have touched on one of the, two of the questions I'm going to ask.
sentences.zh: 先生们，让我转到关于未来的问题，因为你们俩都触及了我将要问的两个问题中的一个。

sentences.en: Alex, I wonder if you thought that Joe Biden made clear the distinctions of how he would handle the pandemic versus how the president has handled the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯，我想知道你是否认为乔·拜登阐明了他将如何处理大流行病与总统处理方式之间的区别。

sentences.en: Because I have to imagine that there are Americans for whom the pandemic is clearly the issue, the leading issue in this election.
sentences.zh: 因为我不得不想象，对于一些美国人来说，大流行病显然是这次选举中的首要议题。

sentences.en: But they aren't quite sure what Joe Biden would do about it.
sentences.zh: 但他们不太确定乔·拜登会对此做些什么。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think that there are clear contrasts about, you know, who is respectful of medical science generally, who believes in measures like mask wearing and social distancing.
sentences.zh: 我认为在谁普遍尊重医学科学、谁相信戴口罩和社交距离等措施方面，存在着清晰的对比。

sentences.en: I don't know that there is, in the minds of most voters,
sentences.zh: 我不知道在大多数选民心中，

sentences.en: a more cohesive sense of what would a Biden-led America have done starting in February or earlier and running through today and what might our lives look like under those circumstances.
sentences.zh: 是否有一个更连贯的概念，即拜登领导下的美国从二月或更早开始一直到今天会做些什么，以及在这些情况下我们的生活会是什么样子。

sentences.en: I do think it's one of those opportunities that's still just kind of sitting out there for Biden to talk in a more extensive and far-reaching way about how different Americans' lives might be if we had handled this the way other countries did.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为这是一个仍然摆在拜登面前的机会，让他以更广泛和深远的方式谈论，如果我们像其他国家那样处理这件事，美国人的生活会有多么不同。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费探索《时报》一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用程序中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 一个月的时间去越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So next up, Alex, in this strategy of the presidents and this debate,
sentences.zh: 那么接下来，亚历克斯，在总统的策略和这次辩论中，

sentences.en: seemed to be his effort to paint Biden as a tool of the left and to convince voters that he would govern outside the mainstream.
sentences.zh: 他似乎努力将拜登描绘成左翼的工具，并说服选民他会在主流之外进行治理。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Joe, you agreed with Bernie Sanders, the far left, on the manifesto, we call it.
sentences.zh: 乔，你同意伯尼·桑德斯，也就是极左派，关于宣言的观点，我们称之为宣言。

sentences.en: And that gives you socialized medicine.
sentences.zh: 那会给你带来社会主义医疗。

sentences.en: If there was a through line to the president's attacks on Biden tonight, that was it.
sentences.zh: 如果说今晚总统对拜登的攻击有一条贯穿始终的线索，那就是这个。

sentences.en: This idea that when it comes to health care.
sentences.zh: 这个关于医疗保健的想法。

sentences.en: You agreed with Bernie Sanders on a plan.
sentences.zh: 你同意伯尼·桑德斯的计划。

sentences.en: Joe Biden and the Democratic Party are way to the left.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登和民主党太偏左了。

sentences.en: Do you have any idea what this mom's doing?
sentences.zh: 你知道这位妈妈在做什么吗？

sentences.en: That's true.
sentences.zh: 那是真的。

sentences.en: Do you have anything to do?
sentences.zh: 你有什么事要做吗？

sentences.en: Socialized medicine.
sentences.zh: 社会主义医疗。

sentences.en: They want to end private insurance and do Medicare for all.
sentences.zh: 他们想要终结私人保险，实行全民医保。

sentences.en: And here's the deal.
sentences.zh: 事实是这样的。

sentences.en: He's talking about the Green New Deal.
sentences.zh: 他在谈论绿色新政。

sentences.en: And when it comes to energy, they want to.
sentences.zh: 当谈到能源时，他们想要。

sentences.en: As you said, it's $100 trillion.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，那是100万亿美元。

sentences.en: You know, he talked about implementing the Green New Deal, and he talked about more specifically.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他谈到了实施绿色新政，而且他谈得更具体。

sentences.en: Where airplanes are out of business, where two car systems are out, where they want to take out the cows, too.
sentences.zh: 飞机要停业，两车系统要取消，他们还想把牛也处理掉。

sentences.en: You know, that's not true either, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，那也不是真的，对吧？

sentences.en: Like getting rid of cows and some other sort of outlandish caricatures of what the left wing of the Democratic Party wants to do.
sentences.zh: 比如摆脱牛和其他一些关于民主党左翼想要做什么的古怪漫画式的描述。

sentences.en: And on law and order.
sentences.zh: 还有关于法律和秩序。

sentences.en: So we have to be engaged.
sentences.zh: 所以我们必须参与其中。

sentences.en: That's not what they're talking about, Chris.
sentences.zh: 那不是他们在谈论的，克里斯。

sentences.en: That's not what they're talking about.
sentences.zh: 那不是他们在谈论的。

sentences.en: He's talking about defunding the police.
sentences.zh: 他在谈论削减警察经费。

sentences.en: That is not true.
sentences.zh: 那不是真的。

sentences.en: And he doesn't want to say law and order because he can't, because he'll lose his radical left supporters.
sentences.zh: 而且他不想说法律和秩序，因为他不能，因为他会失去他的激进左翼支持者。

sentences.en: And once he does that, it's over with.
sentences.zh: 一旦他那样做了，一切就结束了。

sentences.en: But if he ever got to run this country and they ran it the way he would want to run it, we would have—
sentences.zh: 但如果他真的有机会管理这个国家，并且他们按照他想要的方式去管理，我们就会——

sentences.en: Our suburbs would be gone.
sentences.zh: 我们的郊区就会消失。

sentences.en: By the way, our suburbs would be gone.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我们的郊区就会消失。

sentences.en: Over and over, we heard the president accuse Biden of taking these far left positions, and Biden would just say, no, I don't.
sentences.zh: 我们一次又一次地听到总统指责拜登采取这些极左立场，而拜登只会说，不，我没有。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's not my position.
sentences.zh: 那不是我的立场。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The fact of the matter is, I beat Bernie Sanders.
sentences.zh: 事实是，我击败了伯尼·桑德斯。

sentences.en: Not by much.
sentences.zh: 不是以微弱优势。

sentences.en: I beat him a whole hell of a lot.
sentences.zh: 我以巨大的优势击败了他。

sentences.en: I'm here standing facing you.
sentences.zh: 我站在这里面对着你。

sentences.en: To me, one of the most telling moments of the debate was when Biden was distancing himself from one or another of those proposals.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，辩论中最能说明问题的一个时刻是拜登试图与那些提案中的某一个或另一个保持距离的时候。

sentences.en: And the president was saying, well, you know, your party is that far left.
sentences.zh: 总统当时说，嗯，你知道，你的党派是极左的。

sentences.en: And it's not what your party is saying.
sentences.zh: 而且这并不是你们党派所说的。

sentences.en: That is simply a lie.
sentences.zh: 那纯粹是谎言。

sentences.en: Your party doesn't say it.
sentences.zh: 你们党派并没有那样说。

sentences.en: Your party wants to go socialist medicine and socialist health care.
sentences.zh: 你们党派想要搞社会主义医疗和社会主义医保。

sentences.en: And Biden's response was, I am the Democratic Party right now.
sentences.zh: 而拜登的回应是，我现在就是民主党。

sentences.en: I am the Democratic Party right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在就是民主党。

sentences.en: The platform of the Democratic Party is what I, in fact, approved of.
sentences.zh: 民主党的纲领就是我实际上所认可的。

sentences.en: What I approved of.
sentences.zh: 我所认可的。

sentences.en: Which, you know, is something of a questionable assertion.
sentences.zh: 这，你知道，是一个值得商榷的断言。

sentences.en: I don't know that it's really the case that the totality of the Democratic Party is best represented by Joe Biden at this time.
sentences.zh: 我不知道民主党的整体在此时此刻是否真的能最好地由乔·拜登来代表。

sentences.en: But as a practical matter, it's true.
sentences.zh: 但从实际情况来看，这是事实。

sentences.en: Joe Biden is the standard bearer of the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登是民主党的旗手。

sentences.en: If the next president is a Democrat, it will be him.
sentences.zh: 如果下一任总统是民主党人，那一定是他。

sentences.en: And I'm not sure that the president has figured out how to work around the reality that his opponent is a pretty mainstream political figure.
sentences.zh: 我不确定总统是否已经想出如何绕过这样一个现实，即他的对手是一个相当主流的政治人物。

sentences.en: Well,

sentences.zh: 锁定胜局的那种辩论时刻的机会。

sentences.en: But again, at a cost to himself.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，他自己也付出了代价。

sentences.en: And we're now at a point in the campaign where we only have less than five weeks left until Election Day.
sentences.zh: 现在距离大选日只剩下不到五周了。

sentences.en: More than a million people have already voted.
sentences.zh: 已经有超过一百万人投了票。

sentences.en: The president is losing in the polls.
sentences.zh: 总统在民调中处于落后。

sentences.en: And every day that he does not fundamentally change the structure of the race is a day that he continues to lose.
sentences.zh: 而他每一天没能从根本上改变选情结构，就是他继续落后的一天。

sentences.en: So in that not terribly inspiring calculus, it's probably a better night for Joe Biden than for the president.
sentences.zh: 所以，在这一番并不怎么令人振奋的盘算下，这对乔·拜登来说可能比对总统来说要好过一些。

sentences.en: That doesn't mean it was a fantastic night for anybody.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着这对任何人来说是一个美妙的夜晚。

sentences.en: Or for the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 对美利坚合众国来说也不是。

sentences.en: It was a shit show for the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 这对美利坚合众国来说就是一场闹剧。

sentences.en: Well, Alex, I truly cannot wait to do this again with you.
sentences.zh: 好吧，亚历克斯，我真的迫不及待想再和你一起做节目了。

sentences.en: And then one more time after that.
sentences.zh: 之后还有最后一次。

sentences.en: I'll look forward to it.
sentences.zh: 我很期待。

sentences.en: Thank you, Alex.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，亚历克斯。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 周二，

sentences.en: New York City Mayor Bill de Blasio announced a significant uptick in the daily rate of positive tests for the coronavirus to the highest number that the city has experienced since June.
sentences.zh: 纽约市长白思豪宣布，该市新冠病毒检测阳性率显著上升，达到自6月以来的最高水平。

sentences.en: For the first time in months, you're going to see a daily number over 3%.
sentences.zh: 几个月来，你将首次看到日均阳性率超过3%。

sentences.en: And obviously, everyone is concerned about that.
sentences.zh: 显然，每个人都对此感到担忧。

sentences.en: The mayor said that much of the increase came from nine of the city's 146 zip codes, all in Brooklyn and Queens.
sentences.zh: 市长表示，大部分增长来自全市146个邮政编码区域中的9个，全部位于布鲁克林和皇后区。

sentences.en: But it now threatens a citywide plan to reopen schools for in-person classes.
sentences.zh: 但这现在威胁到了全市恢复线下授课的学校重启计划。

sentences.en: Under guidelines established by the mayor, if the positive test rate exceeds 3% over a seven-day rolling average, public schools would automatically close.
sentences.zh: 根据市长制定的指导方针，如果七天滚动平均阳性率超过3%，公立学校将自动关闭。

sentences.en: That is something we all have to work on together to address and something that says to us we have to be on high alert to make sure we fight back this challenge.
sentences.zh: 这是我们所有人必须共同努力解决的问题，也提醒我们必须保持高度警惕，确保我们能击退这一挑战。

sentences.en: And Disney said that it would lay off nearly 30,000 workers, most of them from its theme parks in Florida and California, because of the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 此外，迪士尼表示，受疫情影响，将裁员近3万人，其中大部分来自佛罗里达州和加利福尼亚州的主题公园。

sentences.en: Disneyland in California has been closed for months because of restrictions put in place by the governor there.
sentences.zh: 由于加州州长实施的限制措施，加州的迪士尼乐园已经关闭了数月。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Disney World in Florida reopened in July, but attendance has been weaker than Disney had expected.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，佛罗里达州的迪士尼世界于7月重新开放，但入园人数低于迪士尼的预期。
